adaptation: Local models, explicit references, custom scene/action prompts, 4-step FL2VA sampling, 1344x768 production dimensions, no generated soundtrack, and a separate frame-accurate edit. This is not an unchanged end-to-end creator reproduction and does not use Motion Context MultiRef or HyperFrames.

timing.scope: Sum of ComfyUI recorded execution intervals for selected takes. Excludes queue wait, discarded takes, character cards, editing, review and export.

visual_review: Six spread-out frames per source plus selected detailed inspections; numerical checks do not guarantee perfect identity or motion at every pixel.
record_scope: Historical picture-edit record, before bilingual subtitles and the final HyperFrames opening revision. Current delivery hashes are in project.json and media.manifest.json.
